name: TimePicker
purpose: Picks a wall-clock time via hour and minute controls formatted with Intl.

onChange.description: Called with the HH:mm string on change.

hourLabel.description: Accessible label for the hour control.

minuteLabel.description: Accessible label for the minute control.

antiPatterns: Do not hand-pad time strings; use Intl-aware formatting helpers.
Do not mix 12h and 24h presentation in one form.

keyboard: Arrow keys step values in the selects
a11y.focus: Hour and minute selects are in tab order.
a11y.labeling: Group label plus per-select labels describe the time.

responsive.strategy: Inline controls wrap on very narrow screens.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
